messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High alert volume detected on inference-serving-prod — 1.2k alerts in 10m. Paging mike_oncall. Rule: inference/resp-5xx-rate. Link: https://mon.redwood/alerts/2409876543

mike_oncall: jumping in. what is the customer impact? any idea if this is global or one dataplane?

amanda_oncall: quick look — spike concentrated in eu-west-2 dataplane-7. RPS steady, errors are short bursts of identical 502 payloads. attaching prom query I used below.

sara_sre: sounds like a local churn to me. we should avoid blasting PD for each host. propose temporary squelch + dedupe by identical message + grouping by region. reduces noise until we triage.

jon_prod: customer impact: a few PLG customers reported failed inference calls on write-heavy routes, but not widespread. CS already pinged 3 customers; none reported data loss.

mike_oncall: plan: 1) add dedupe for identical error signature 2) rate-limit PD notifications to 1/min 3) make a short-lived heatmap dashboard for hosts+routes 4) follow-up retro to decide permanent threshold changes. who can own steps 1-3?

sara_sre: i can push dedupe + rate-limit. will open a short-lived alert override in alertmanager and a PR to alert-ops. proposed override (applied as temporary):
```yaml
alert: inference_resp_5xx_rate
match: { service: "inference-serving-prod" }
actions:
  - dedupe_key: "$error_message|$route"
  - dedupe_window: 300s  # 5m
  - pd_rate_limit: 1/min
  - group_by: [region]
revert_after: 2h
```

amanda_oncall: i'll make the dashboard and post it here. heatmap by host x route should make the blast radius obvious.

ops-automation-bot: Received request to apply temporary routing. Applying: pd_rate_limit=1/min, dedupe_window=300s, grouping=region for inference/resp-5xx-rate. Reversion scheduled in 2h. :white_check_mark:

sara_sre: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alert-ops/pull/892 (temporary override + playbook snippet). tag @mike_oncall for approval.

mike_oncall: approved. thanks. will watch PD load for 10m. if noise drops, close noisy PD incidents and escalate to permanent grouping + threshold re-eval in retro.

amanda_oncall: dashboard here: https://dashboards.redwood/inference/errors/heatmap?run=2409876543 — initial view shows 85% of alerts from dataplane-7 and most on route /v1/generate-stream. :mag:

jon_prod: customer update: CS sent an interim note to affected tenants; no SLA breach yet. i'll draft a short postmortem blurb if we end up changing thresholds.

mike_oncall: after 12m PD dropped from 18 pages/min to ~1/min. looks effective. leaving override in place until retro, revert scheduled.

sara_sre: follow-ups: (a) add automated test that simulates host churn and verifies dedupe behavior, (b) add grouping_key option for customer_id in alert definitions to avoid multi-tenant noise, (c) propose new 5xx threshold tied to 5m-rolled p95 rather than instantaneous bursts.

amanda_oncall: i'll create the quick heatmap to keep on the incidents page and add it to the runbook.

jon_prod: note for retro: consider adding a tiny synthetic check at route-level to detect cascading failure patterns early.

mike_oncall: thanks team. action items assigned: sara -> PR + tests, amanda -> dashboard + runbook entry, jon -> customer comms + postmortem blurb. i'll close this thread after retro scheduled at 14:00 UTC. :calendar: :thumbsup:

ops-automation-bot: Reminder: temporary override will auto-revert at +2h (2409883743) unless a maintainer extends it.

mike_oncall: closing active PD incidents for this signature now since noise is reduced. we keep the override until retro. good job everyone.
